mn108:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe aciraparinibbute bhagavati.
mn108:2.1: tena kho pana samayena rājā māgadho ajātasattu vedehiputto rājagahaṃ paṭisaṅkhārāpeti rañño pajjotassa āsaṅkamāno.
mn108:3.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
mn108:3.4: yannūnāhaṃ yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto, yena gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkameyya’nti.
mn108:4.1: atha kho āyasmā ānando yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto, yena gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo, tenupasaṅkami.
mn108:4.2: addasā kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
mn108:4.6: cirassaṃ kho bhavaṃ ānando imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idhāgamanāya.
mn108:4.8: nisīdi kho āyasmā ānando paññatte āsane.
mn108:4.9: gopakamoggallānopi kho brāhmaṇo aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn108:4.10: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn108:5.1: atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi tehi dhammehi sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ samannāgato, yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti.
mn108:5.2: natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi tehi dhammehi sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ samannāgato, yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
mn108:5.3: so hi brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū, maggavidū, maggakovido.
mn108:5.4: maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā’ti.
mn108:6.1: ayañca hidaṃ āyasmato ānandassa gopakamoggallānena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ antarākathā vippakatā hoti.
mn108:6.2: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto rājagahe kammante anusaññāyamāno yena gopakamoggallānassa brāhmaṇassa kammanto yena āyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn108:6.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn108:6.4: kāyanuttha bho ānanda, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā’ti?
mn108:6.5: idha maṃ brāhmaṇa, gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo evamāha:
mn108:6.6: ‘atthi nu kho, bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi tehi dhammehi sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ samannāgato, yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho’ti.
mn108:6.7: evaṃ vutte ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, gopakamoggallānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocaṃ:
mn108:6.8: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi tehi dhammehi sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ samannāgato, yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
mn108:6.9: so hi brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido,
mn108:6.10: maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā’ti.
mn108:6.11: ayaṃ kho no brāhmaṇa, gopakamoggallānena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ antarākathā vippakatā.
mn108:7.1: atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito:
mn108:7.2: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthā’ti?
mn108:7.3: natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito:
mn108:7.4: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti.
mn108:8.1: atthi pana kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:8.2: ‘ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthā’ti?
mn108:8.3: natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato, sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:8.4: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti.
mn108:9.1: evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana, bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā’ti?
mn108:10.1: ‘atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito:
mn108:10.2: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthā’ti.
mn108:10.3: iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito:
mn108:10.4: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti vadesi.
mn108:10.5: ‘atthi pana bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:10.6: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthā’ti.
mn108:10.7: iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:10.8: ‘ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti
mn108:10.10: ‘evaṃ appaṭisaraṇe ca pana bho ānanda, ko hetu sāmaggiyā’ti. iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘na kho mayaṃ brāhmaṇa , appaṭisaraṇā
mn108:10.13: imassa pana bho ānanda, bhāsitassa kathaṃ attho daṭṭhabbo’ti?
mn108:10.14: atthi kho brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ, pātimokkhaṃ uddiṭṭhaṃ.
mn108:10.15: te mayaṃ tadahuposathe yāvatikā ekaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ upanissāya viharāma. te sabbe ekajjhaṃ sannipatāma,
mn108:10.16: sannipatitvā yassa taṃ pavattati taṃ ajjhesāma.
mn108:10.17: tasmiṃ ce bhaññamāne hoti bhikkhussa āpatti, hoti vītikkamo, taṃ mayaṃ yathādhammaṃ yathānusiṭṭhaṃ kāremā’ti.
mn108:11.1: atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi yaṃ tumhe etarahi sakkarotha, garukarotha, mānetha, pūjetha, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya viharathā’ti?
mn108:11.2: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma, garukaroma, mānema, pūjema. sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharāmā’ti.
mn108:11.3: ‘atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhotā gotamena ṭhapito:
mn108:11.4: ‘ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatīti yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthā’ti.
mn108:11.5: iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena ṭhapito:
mn108:12.1: ayaṃ vo mamaccayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti. yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti vadesi.
mn108:12.2: ‘atthi pana bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:12.3: ‘ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti yaṃ tumhe etarahi paṭidhāveyyāthāti.
mn108:12.4: iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi saṅghena sammato sambahulehi therehi bhikkhūhi ṭhapito:
mn108:12.5: ayaṃ no bhagavato accayena paṭisaraṇaṃ bhavissatī’ti, yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi paṭidhāveyyāmā’ti vadesi.
mn108:12.6: atthi nu kho bho ānanda, ekabhikkhūpi yaṃ tumhe etarahi sakkarotha, garukarotha, mānetha, pūjetha, sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharathā’ti
mn108:12.7: iti puṭṭho samāno: ‘natthi kho brāhmaṇa, ekabhikkhūpi yaṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garukaroma mānema pūjema sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharāmā’ti vadesi.
mn108:12.8: imassa pana bho ānanda, bhāsitassa kathaṃ attho daṭṭhabboti.
mn108:13.1: atthi kho brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa pasādanīyā dhammā akkhātā,
mn108:13.2: yasmiṃ no ime dhammā saṃvijjanti. taṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garukaroma mānema pūjema. sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharāma.
mn108:14.1: idha brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.
mn108:15.2: ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpāssa dhammā bahussutā honti, dhatā vacasā paricitā manasānupekkhitā diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.
mn108:17.1: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
mn108:18.1: anekavihitaṃ iddhividhaṃ paccanubhoti: ekopi hutvā bahudhā hoti, bahudhāpi hutvā eko hoti, āvibhāvaṃ tirobhāvaṃ tirokuḍḍaṃ tiropākāraṃ tiropabbataṃ asajjamāno gacchati seyyathāpi ākāse. pathaviyāpi ummujjanimujjaṃ karoti seyyathāpi udake. udakepi abhijjamāne gacchati seyyathāpi paṭhaviyaṃ. ākāsepi pallaṅkena caṅkamati seyyathāpi pakkhī sakuṇo. imepi candimasuriye evaṃ mahiddhike evaṃmahānubhāve pāṇinā parimasati, parimajjati. yāva brahmalokāpi kāyena vasaṃ vatteti.
mn108:19.1: dibbāya sotadhātuyā visuddhāya atikkantamānusikāya ubho sadde suṇāti dibbe ca mānuse ca ye dūre santike ca.
mn108:20.1: parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ cetasā ceto paricca pajānāti:
mn108:20.2: sarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ sarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.3: vītarāgaṃ vā cittaṃ vītarāgaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.4: sadosaṃ vā cittaṃ sadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.5: vītadosaṃ vā cittaṃ vītadosaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.6: samohaṃ vā cittaṃ samohaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.7: vītamohaṃ vā cittaṃ vītamohaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.8: saṃkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ saṃkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.9: vikkhittaṃ vā cittaṃ vikkhittaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.10: mahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ mahaggataṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.11: amahaggataṃ vā cittaṃ amahaggataṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.12: sauttaraṃ vā cittaṃ sauttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.13: anuttaraṃ vā cittaṃ anuttaraṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.14: samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.15: asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ asamāhitaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.16: vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:20.17: avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ avimuttaṃ cittanti pajānāti.
mn108:21.1: anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathidaṃ: ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo tissopi jātiyo catassopi jātiyo pañcapi jātiyo dasapi jātiyo vīsampi jātiyo tiṃsampi jātiyo cattārīsampi jātiyo paññāsampi jātiyo jātisatampi jātisahassampi jātisatasahassampi anekepi saṃvaṭṭakappe anekepi vivaṭṭakappe anekepi saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe, amutrāsiṃ evannāmo evaṅgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto amutra udapādiṃ, tatrāpāsiṃ evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto evaṃvaṇṇo evamāhāro evaṃsukhadukkhapaṭisaṃvedī evamāyupariyanto. so tato cuto idhūpapanno’ti. iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati.
mn108:22.1: dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti.
mn108:23.1: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
mn108:23.2: ime kho brāhmaṇa, tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena dasa pasādanīyā dhammā akkhātā.
mn108:23.3: yasmiṃ no ime dhammā saṃvijjanti, taṃ mayaṃ etarahi sakkaroma garukaroma mānema pūjema, sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya viharāmāti.
mn108:24.1: evaṃ vutte vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto upanandaṃ senāpatiṃ āmantesi.
mn108:24.2: taṃ kiṃ maññasi bhavaṃ senāpati, yadime evaṃ bhonto sakkātabbaṃ sakkaronti, garukātabbaṃ garukaronti,
mn108:24.4: tagghime bhonto sakkātabbaṃ sakkaronti, garukātabbaṃ garukaronti, mānetabbaṃ mānenti, pūjetabbaṃ pūjenti.
mn108:24.5: imañca hi te bhonto na sakkareyyuṃ, na garukareyyuṃ, na māneyyuṃ, na pūjeyyuṃ,
mn108:24.6: atha kiñcarahi te bhonto sakkareyyuṃ, garukareyyuṃ, māneyyuṃ, pūjeyyuṃ, sakkatvā garukatvā upanissāya vihareyyunti.
mn108:25.1: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn108:25.3: veḷuvane kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa etarahi viharāmīti.
mn108:25.4: kacci pana bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppanti.
mn108:25.5: taggha brāhmaṇa, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ, yathā taṃ tumhādisehi rakkhakehi gopakehīti.
mn108:25.6: taggha bho ānanda, veḷuvanaṃ ramaṇīyañceva appasaddañca appanigghosañca vijanavātaṃ manussarāhaseyyakaṃ paṭisallānasāruppaṃ yathā taṃ bhavantehi jhānasīlīhi.
mn108:25.8: ekamidāhaṃ bho ānanda, samayaṃ so bhavaṃ gotamo vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
mn108:25.9: atha kho ahaṃ bho ānanda, yena mahāvanaṃ kūṭāgārasālā, yena so bhavaṃ gotamo, tenupasaṅkamiṃ.
mn108:25.10: tatra ca pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anekapariyāyena jhānakathaṃ kathesi.
mn108:25.11: jhāyī ceva so bhavaṃ gotamo ahosi jhānasīlī ca.
mn108:25.12: sabbañca pana so bhavaṃ gotamo jhānaṃ vaṇṇesīti.
mn108:26.1: na kho brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ vaṇṇesi. nāpi so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesīti.
mn108:26.2: kathaṃ rūpañca brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesi.
mn108:26.3: idha brāhmaṇa, ekacco kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati kāmarāgaparetena. uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti:
mn108:26.4: so kāmarāgaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
mn108:26.5: byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati byāpādaparetena. uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn108:26.6: so byāpādaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
mn108:26.7: thīnamiddhapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati thīnamiddhaparetena. uppannassa ca thīnamiddhassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn108:26.8: so thīnamiddhaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
mn108:26.9: uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena. uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn108:26.10: so uddhaccakukkuccaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
mn108:26.11: vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati vicikicchāparetena. uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn108:26.12: so vicikicchaṃyeva antaraṃ karitvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.
mn108:26.13: evarūpaṃ kho brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesi.
mn108:27.1: kathaṃ rūpañca brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ vaṇṇesi.
mn108:27.2: idha brāhmaṇa, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn108:27.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī’ti taṃ
mn108:27.4: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati. sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ
mn108:27.6: evarūpaṃ kho brāhmaṇa so bhagavā jhānaṃ vaṇṇesīti.
mn108:28.1: gārayhaṃ kira bho ānanda, so bhavaṃ gotamo jhānaṃ garahi. pāsaṃsaṃ pasaṃsi.
mn108:28.2: handa ca’dāni mayaṃ bho ānanda gacchāma
mn108:28.5: atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi.
mn108:29.1: atha kho gopakamoggallāno brāhmaṇo acirapakkante vassakāre brāhmaṇe magadhamahāmatte āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca:
mn108:29.2: ‘yaṃ no mayaṃ bhavantaṃ ānandaṃ apucchimha taṃ no bhavaṃ ānando na byākāsīti.
mn108:29.4: natthi kho brāhmaṇa ekabhikkhūpi tehi dhammehi sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbaṃ samannāgato, yehi dhammehi samannāgato so bhagavā ahosi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.
mn108:29.5: so hi brāhmaṇa, bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido
mn108:29.6: maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatāti.
